title: Genesis TSS-mapping sample sheet
description: One row per single-read TSS library: the TSS is the 5' end of read 1. workflows/tss-seq.nf also checks the exact header, reference files, reference IDs and per-reference consistency.

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must start with a letter, digit or underscore and contain only letters, digits, underscores, periods and hyphens

species.errorMessage: species must start with a letter, digit or underscore and contain only letters, digits, underscores, periods and hyphens

read1_url.errorMessage: read1_url must be an HTTP or HTTPS URL of the gzipped FASTQ whose reads start at the TSS

method.errorMessage: method must be CAGE, nAnT-iCAGE, TSS-seq, oligo-capping or csRNA-seq

trim_5p.errorMessage: trim_5p must be the number of bases (1-99) to remove from the start of each read, such as a barcode, or - for none

adapter_3p.errorMessage: adapter_3p must be the 3' adapter sequence (at least 6 bases of A, C, G, T, N), or - for none

reference_fasta.errorMessage: reference_fasta must be a gzipped FASTA basename ending in .fa.gz, .fasta.gz or .fna.gz

reference_annotation.errorMessage: reference_annotation must be a GFF3 or GTF basename (.gff3, .gff or .gtf, optionally .gz) in the references folder

organelle_contigs.errorMessage: organelle_contigs must be comma-separated contig names, or - for none
